scope: Existing dynamic evidence for the g-capable assets and exact historical Cologne package. Counts and input schemas only, new simulations 0, new fits 0. Historical responses and costs were not used in selecting sources.

salt_lake.demand_clock: 65 complete Q1 2023 weekdays, pooled 17:00–18:00 coordinate-wise five-minute median. Deterministic demand construction, original upstream route templates are empty.
salt_lake.current_config_check: Both current frozen snapshot directories contain sumocfg, net and route files. Plain server CFCMT/cf_h2o checkout does not contain these derived directories.
salt_lake.admission_contents: admission.json and eight tripinfo XML files (one per two scenarios x four controllers). Five-minute movement_profile is a demand input. Trip-level outputs and profile totals cannot determine per-lane near vehicles at a ten-second decision.

v114.metadata_evidence: For one shard in each of both Salt Lake networks, Ingolstadt7, arterial4x4 and Cologne1, inspected NPZ directory/field names. Salt Lake schema has 63 aggregate action features and 24 context features. Metadata carries row times, focal TLS and candidate states. Source input lacks vehicle-to-stopline distances by lane for exact own-g and simultaneous priority-G supply.
v114.snapshot_storage: Captured SUMO states were temporary at /dev/shm under sumo_state_directory; cf_h2o/sumo_runtime.py uses TemporaryDirectory. The cache products store summaries and response arrays.
v114.safety_exclusion: Ingolstadt21: no retained groups; three unsafe native audit runs. See cf_h2o/config/traffic_signal_tsc_v114_source_pure_waiting_admission_v2.json.

cologne_native.exact_program: Repaired Cologne1 cluster_357187_359543 program 0 has 8 stable candidates. Across those candidates, g occurs on four left and four U-turn edge-pair movements only. Incoming movement lanes in this sample are all shared.

implication: Historic demand, admission, action-group counts and aggregate green/red queues cannot establish dynamic joint supply for a new source network. Only a static movement and right-of-way match could justify a separately frozen preaction measurement pilot.
